I replied to Pree in her thread in #central-random: the ticket is **#8841**.

That number comes from #central-random, which Pree is in. On Oct 13 at 09:27, Tobias Rendle posted there that West yard Door 2 is "still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk," and that he had flagged it on ticket #8841 for support. Hollis called it "Tobias's dealer account," and the account record lists Tobias as the owner of Marrow Fieldworks, so this is the right account. I suggested she check with Tobias for the latest status before her call.

A ticket number is an account fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to share with Pree. She's on the Central team.

There's a possible mix-up: a separate April 2026 meeting note mentions "#PD-8841 maybe?" for a different kiosk issue (a high-contrast display mode). I didn't bring that up with Pree, but if the tracker needs a full ticket ID, Tobias should confirm whether #8841 has a prefix.
